name: Cryo Cooler
description: A component that cools liquid A and transfers the heat to liquid B.
shortDescription: A powered component that creates a temperature difference between two liquid systems.

logicNodes.label: On/Off
logicNodes.description: Controls whether or not the component transfers heat between liquids.

logicNodes.label: Liquid A In
logicNodes.description: Input liquid port for liquid that gets cooled.

logicNodes.label: Liquid A Out
logicNodes.description: Output liquid port for liquid that gets cooled.

logicNodes.label: Liquid B In
logicNodes.description: Input liquid port for liquid that gets warmed.

logicNodes.label: Liquid B Out
logicNodes.description: Output liquid port for liquid that gets warmed.
